rs.innovation_approach: 先用随机替换/移除latent和训练动态检验“生成了latent就使用了它”的前提，再把第一层后续文本对latent的注意力质量加入VLPO结果奖励，让latent可作为训练辅助表征而不要求最终持续生成。
rs.key_step: 在old-policy logprob前向中读取第一层多头平均attention，累计后续文本到所有latent的质量并按后续文本数取平均；无latent为0；与正确性/格式加权后做组内mean+std。
rs.why_non_obvious: 训练期的表征辅助与推理期显式格式不是同一件事；latent可以在RL末期消失而改善保留。但attention只是利用代理，既受长度影响也不是动作必要性。
rs.trigger_condition: When latent generation persists as a format without reliable downstream dependence, reward downstream interaction during post-training while allowing the model to stop emitting latents at inference.

rs.abstract_strategy: Separate the value of an intermediate computation during learning from its visible persistence at deployment.
rs.abstract_key_step: Measure how later outputs attend to generated intermediate states, add that proxy to outcome reward, and allow the generating mode to disappear.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: An intermediate state can help shape parameters without remaining useful on each deployed input; observing its presence alone cannot establish its contribution.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When an intermediate format can be removed without losing deployed accuracy, test whether interaction with its contents still improves learning.

limitations.text: Two representative latent-framework families only; not a broad architectural generalization.
limitations.quote:
Our study focuses on two representative latent visual reasoning frameworks, Monet and LVR. These
models cover common designs for injecting continuous visual latents into multimodal reasoning, yet
future methods may use different latent construction mechanisms. It would be valuable to examine
whether the observed RL dynamics and the benefits of the attention reward hold across a broader
range of latent reasoning architectures.

limitations.text: Attention is a proxy; authors explicitly leave stronger counterfactual contribution measurements and broader hyperparameter sweeps for future work.
limitations.quote:
Our attention reward uses attention mass as a proxy for latent utilization. This provides an efficient
training signal. Future work could combine attention-based rewards with stronger counterfactual
measurements of latent contribution. In addition, our experiments are conducted under limited
computational budgets, so larger-scale post-training and broader hyperparameter sweeps may further
clarify when latent reasoning is most beneficial.

limitations.text: Single-run protocol explicitly acknowledged; no repeat-run uncertainty.
limitations.quote:
Due to the substantial compute and API cost of latent-space RL, fully repeating both VLPO and our
method across several seeds and architectures exceeds our available budget. The current one-run
protocol follows the previous works, where LVR and Monet don’t report standard deviation either.

question.observed_failure: Table1: Monet-SFT→Monet-RL ViRL39K latent trigger36.1→10.0% attemp.5 and18.9→5.4% at1.0; Thyme69.2→55.0% and40.7→32.4%. Fig1 replacement/removal often maintains accuracy. Extra RN training drives latent usage to≈0 even faster (Fig2), despite continued task performance.
question.load_bearing_assumption: Generation of an intermediate latent format implies its contents causally contribute to the final answer and should remain in every inference response.
question.scope: SFT/RL behavior of Monet and adapted LVR on visual reasoning; latent-representation use as training signal, no crop-tool interaction study.
question.success_criterion: Reported: outperform matchingVLPO on multiple benchmarks while final latent generation may disappear; real-vs-random latent training and attribution should distinguish content dependence from mere formatting. No preregistered noninferiority or seed-powered criterion.
question.why_open: Existing correctness/format rewards supervise outcome and latent format without proving utilization; an explicit sampled necessity bonus instead encourages skipping latent mode. Authors turn to a cheap attention interaction proxy.

equations.latex: R_A^i=\frac{1}{|T_t|}\sum_{j\in T_t}\sum_{k\in T_L}A_{j,k},\quad R_A^i=0\ \text{if no latents}
equations.note: First decoder layer; mean over attention heads; normalized by post-latent text count, not latent count. No clipping.
KL written outside sums as printed. Token-level KL allocation and continuous-latent KL treatment not specified.
Printed continuous-token ratio is a Gaussian similarity kernel;σ=10 Table9. This is not the categorical next-token ratio. No derivation or likelihood calibration proof supplied in this paper.
r_i/r_j here are binary branch accuracies, not Eq2 total reward. Printed n vs prose N=1 retained. RN is a diagnostic alternative, not combined with final RA in reported main method.

objective.signal_routing: RA is computed from post-latent-to-latent attention but added to whole-response reward before standardization. The same scalar A_i is broadcast to text and latent tokens, including mode switches; ratios differ by token type. It is not attention-token masking or local crop credit. AppendixD extracts attention from old policy scoring, no extra learned judge or direct differentiable RA auxiliary loss reported.
objective.normalization: Two stages: attention heads averaged and attention mass divided by|post-latent text|; then total correctness+format+attention reward mean/std normalized per8 rollouts. Eq3 averages per response length and across group. No epsilon/zero-variance convention given. KLβ appears but numeric coefficient is not in Table9 despite §5.1 promise.
objective.invariance: Not PBRS or an action-independent baseline: additive RA changes preferences/expected gradient. Group standardization is invariant to shared positive affine rescaling; therefore if accuracy/format are identical and only positive w3RA varies, w3 cancels (reader algebra, ignoring unspecified epsilon). Relative term weights matter in mixed groups. RA incentivizes format/attention concentration and may shorten responses; no guarantee of unchanged optimal task policy or crop economy.
objective.baseline_or_potential: Empirical same-prompt group mean/std. Old/current/reference policies play distinct scoring/ratio/KL roles. No learned critic or potential. RN uses a policy continuation conditioned on same pre-latent text and forced empty latent block, not an action-independent baseline.
objective.degenerate_cases: No latent→RA0; if mode probability≈0, attention reward cannot be observed and provides no support rescue (empirically mode disappears). All-correct/all-wrong same-format groups can still have nonzero attention advantages ifRA varies; identicalRA yields undefined0/0 in printed formula, convention unknown. Uniformly zeroRA returns VLPO. Empty post-latent text leaves1/|Tt| undefined, handling unknown. Fixed average pertext does not remove length-position confound; varying latent count changes summed mass. Positive RA can favor an incorrect latent response over a correct one in extreme theoretical range (weights do not impose strict accuracy priority), though observedRA small. For printed latent ratio, r≤1 and derivative wrt hθ is0 at hθ=hold; this is an algebraic property, not a runtime finding about actual sampled latent updates.

negative_results.text: Necessity reward drives latent generation down faster; Table10 MMVP73.0→65.0 despiteMathVista60.5→71.3, so no uniformly maintained quality.
negative_results.quote:
As shown in Figure 2 (smoothed every 10 steps), this reward drives the model
to skip latent generation even faster than vanilla RL while maintaining response quality.

negative_results.text: Latent/text preference differs bymodel andquestion. Natural grouped results do not establish that a learned task router must fail.
negative_results.quote:
For LVR-SFT∗ , the trend is
different: pure-text responses are more competitive in most clusters. Therefore, a single coarse
question type cannot explain latent preference, and it is not consistent across model families.

negative_results.text: Failure examples remain: wrongfinal answer despite a procedural reasoning plan and wrongspatial object relation.
negative_results.quote:
Figure 12: Our model may fail to produce the correct final answer despite demonstrating correct
reasoning toward a solution, which could be a hallucination inherited from the base model.

evidence_design.seeds: single: AppendixD explicitly states current one-run protocol. No confidence intervals, seed sweep or significance test. Two latent frameworks are not independent seeds, and both use related backbones.
evidence_design.falsifier: Proposed, not executed: atmatched token/attention mass, random or permuted latent content must fail to reproduceRA benefits across repeated seeds; independently perturb high-attribution visual regions vs size/location matched control regions and compare answer change. If matchedstyle/length changes explain gains, orRA rises while causal pixel dependence/held-out accuracy does not, attention-as-use mechanism is unsupported.
evidence_design.causal_limits: GxI/IG sensitivity and modest correlations(.247/.301 atstep60) are not correct-answer necessity or faithful grounding proofs. IG baseline/integration details and entropy construction are underspecified. Conditioning attribution analyses on surviving latent responses creates selection across checkpoints. RegionAUC.669vs.639VLPO/.654SFT supports association, not closed-loop necessity.

Therefore, we perform an additional SFT stage with the latent target randomly

pitfalls.text: Attention reward has a length/position preference; conciseoutputs are a possible sideeffect, not isolated grounding evidence.
pitfalls.quote:
In transformers, attention
from later text tokens to a fixed early prefix can naturally decrease as the context grows. Longer
continuations therefore reduce average attention to latent tokens. This formulation may encourage
the model to generate shorter post-latent textual reasoning while maintaining interaction with visual
latents.

pitfalls.text: Attention extraction needs no additional trainable module but does require accessing firstlayer oldpolicy attentions; deployment engine support is separate.
pitfalls.quote:

decoder layer during the log-probability computation of the old policy.

engineering.lesson: 当一种中间表示只是被模型按格式生成时，先做保持位置的内容替换和移除对照，再区分训练辅助价值与推理必要性；注意力可作低开销代理，但要同时核对长度、随机内容负对照、真实区域依赖及单种子不确定性。

relevance.how: 同前缀移除/随机替换中间表示的诊断可借鉴；也直接提醒这些替换改变后续分布，不能把单次答错当因果必要性。
原LVR格式总触发，额外latent-dropSFT补两种行为，说明RL诊断之前必须核采样支持；本篇没有多轮recheck行为。
观察RL模式消失并给出初期支持证据；消失方向为latent而本任务常为直答，不能搬成同一结论。
RN同前缀分支是邻近必要性诊断，但最终RA仍全轨信用，无逐次crop价值/路由。
关注中间表示是否参与答案生成而非只存在；latent注意力不直接监测caption事实性/充分性。
真实vs随机latent训练负对照和GTregionAUC可启发防hack评测；本任务GT目标框缺失，不可直接迁移AUC指标。
明确单run且无误差条，跨benchmark不能替代种子重复。
在oldpolicy打分时读取attention是低附加开销设计；Qwen3/crop多图注意力算子、显存和引擎支持尚未验证。

information_boundary.attention_reward: RA observes old-policy attention during complete-rollout scoring. No GT answer or GT region label enters RA itself.
information_boundary.correctness_reward: Racc and RN require correct-answer verification. Table 9 gives accuracy threshold 0.6, but the RL judge model, prompt and score-to-correctness mapping are not specified. Do not borrow the evaluation judge identity.
information_boundary.evaluation: VLMEvalKit with Gemini-2.5-Pro / Gemini-3.1-Pro as judge; exact per-benchmark mapping and prompt unavailable.
information_boundary.ground_truth_regions: 200 held-out Visual-CoT important-region annotations are used for ROC-AUC analysis only, not for the attention reward.
information_boundary.future_information: RA aggregates post-latent text attention and RN compares completed continuations. Neither is a prefix-only decision statistic available before the latent-mode choice.
information_boundary.attribution_target: Length-normalized log-probability of the final-answer span in responses; the paper does not explicitly say it forces a ground-truth answer. IG baseline and integration resolution are unreported.
